from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CaseDocument(BaseModel):
    """A single judgment document parsed for classification purposes."""
    title: str = Field(description="The actual title of the judgment document as provided")
    legal_domain: str = Field(description="The broad legal domain of the case (e.g., 'Administrative Litigation', 'Civil Dispute', 'Criminal Case')")
    dispute_focus: str = Field(description="The specific subject matter or core dispute of the case (e.g., 'Patent Infringement', 'Administrative Demolition', 'Product Liability')")
    key_evidence: list[str] = Field(description="Key facts or clauses that determine the case category")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[CaseDocument]
